# Windsurf Editor Changelog Summary — captured 2026-06-09
# NOTE: windsurf.com/changelog now 308-redirects to docs.devin.ai/desktop/changelog.

## Recent Major Releases

**June 6, 2026 (v3.0.28)** [already reported] - Devin Local: enhanced file-context awareness (recognizes files open in editor); fixed stdio MCP server issues on Windows. Windows migration hardening (preserves app shortcut icons). Remote server startup timeout 2.5s→6s. Streamlined enterprise model picker. [Incremental — below watching-tier major-capability bar; not a coverage finding.]

**June 2, 2026 (v3.0.12)** - "Windsurf is now Devin Desktop." Product rebrand/consolidation under the Devin product line. [Rebrand/identity change — not a coverage finding.]

**May 28, 2026 (v2.3.15)** - Claude Opus 4.8 available (model bump). Devin Local: tracks open files as context; session-level + permanent approval for MCP tools; permission grants persist across sessions; improved plan mode in OS sandbox.

**May 17, 2026 (v2.3.9)** - Fixed swe-check model availability; terminal processing efficiency; restored conversation sharing.

**May 12, 2026** - Claude Opus 4.7 (fast mode) launched.

**May 6, 2026 (v2.2.17)** - Devin Review and Quick Review integrated; Agent Command Center improved.

**April 28, 2026 (v2.1.29)** - Devin for Terminal released; Devin Local agent available in Windsurf.

**April 16, 2026 (v2.0.44)** - **Windsurf 2.0** launch: integrated Devin Cloud agent, Agent Command Center with Kanban view, Spaces.

## Key Features (historical)
- Arena Mode, Plan Mode, Git Worktree Support, Multi-Cascade Panes/Tabs, Cascade Dedicated Terminal, Fast Context, Codemaps, MCP, Windsurf Previews, Web & Docs Search, Auto-Generated Memories.
